# U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)

> The EPA is the federal agency responsible for protecting human health and the environment through regulation, research, and enforcement of environmental laws.

The EPA website provides comprehensive resources on environmental protection, including regulatory guidance, scientific research, emergency response, and public health information on topics ranging from air and water quality to indoor hazards like lead, radon, and mold. The site serves both regulated industries and the general public with compliance information, topic-based resources, and sector-specific regulatory guidance.

## Key Topics

- Air Quality
- Water Quality
- Drinking Water
- Environmental Laws and Regulations
- Compliance and Enforcement
- RCRA (Resource Conservation and Recovery Act)
- TSCA (Toxic Substances Control Act)
- PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances)
- Superfund
- Greenhouse Gas Emissions
- Indoor Air Quality
- Lead
- Radon
- Health Protection
- Emergency Response

## Core Resources & Navigation

- [U.S. Environmental Protection Agency | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov): EPA homepage defining the agency's mission to protect human health and environment
- [Environmental Topics | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/environmental-topics): Central directory of EPA environmental topics, guides, and resources on key issues
- [A - Z Topic Index | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/topics-epa-web): Alphabetical index of all EPA environmental topics and resources

## Laws, Regulations & Compliance

- [Laws & Regulations | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/laws-regulations): Overview of EPA laws, regulations, compliance, and enforcement information
- [Regulatory Information By Business Sector | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-sector): Sector-specific environmental regulatory and compliance guidance by NAICS code
- [Regulatory and Guidance Information By Topic | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/regulatory-information-topic): Topic-based regulatory guidance, laws, and compliance enforcement information

## Research & Science

- [Research | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/research): EPA's Office of Research and Development scientific research products and tools

## Emergency Response

- [Emergency Response | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/emergency-response): EPA resources for emergency response to oil spills, chemical releases, and disasters

## Public Health & Indoor Hazards

- [Lead | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/lead): Comprehensive guide on lead health effects, testing, and RRP rule compliance
- [Radon | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/radon): Information on radon health risks, testing, mitigation, and National Radon Action Plan
- [Mold | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/mold): Guidance on mold control and moisture management for indoor air quality
- [Bed Bugs: Get Them Out and Keep Them Out | US EPA](https://www.epa.gov/bedbugs): Step-by-step guides for bed bug prevention, identification, and treatment using IPM
